The '''Silver Sea''' was an expansive [[Ocean|sea]] on the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Chandrila]]. Located near the Chandrilan [[capital]] of [[Hanna City]], multiple buildings in and around the capital had a view of the sea. In [[5 ABY]], aspiring [[pilot]] [[Temmin Wexley]] trained over the Silver Sea both physically and in a [[flight simulator]]. Later that [[Standard year|year]], [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Desertion|defector]] [[Sinjir Rath Velus]] and several of his [[Norra Wexley's team|companions]] visited a tavern located along the sea's cliffside.

==Description==
Located on the<ref name="Life Debt" /> [[Core Worlds]]<ref name="MT">''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Chandrila]], the Silver Sea was an expanse of calm, [[Color|slate-gray]] [[water]]. Chandrila's [[capital]], [[Hanna City]],<ref name="Life Debt" /> was located near the [[Ocean|sea]],<ref name="Hanna">''[[Last Shot]]'' establishes that the [[Han and Leia's apartment|apartment]] belonging to [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo]] is located in [[Hanna City]]. As ''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' establishes that the Silver Sea's coast is visible from the apartment, Hanna must also be near the [[Ocean|sea]].</ref> as was [[Landing Platform OB-99]]. The [[Leia's office|office]] of New Republic [[general]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] overlooked the sea, as did her [[Han and Leia's apartment|apartment's]] balcony and a [[Unidentified tavern (Chandrila)|tavern]]. Part of the Silver Sea's coast was formed by cliffs against which waves crashed.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> There were also docks located in the sea.<ref name="Princess and the Scoundrel">''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:ChandrilaCoastSenate-GhostsOfVadersCastle2.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Hanna City was located along the coast of the Silver Sea.]]
[[4 ABY|Four years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Date 4">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'' to [[4 ABY]].</ref> former [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] traveled to Chandrila aboard his [[YT-1300 light freighter|starship]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. Solo flew the ''Falcon'' over the Silver Sea, which sparkled beneath the craft.<ref name="Princess and the Scoundrel" />

A [[Standard year|year]] later, in [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Date 5">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> Chandrila's transition from the [[winter]] to [[spring]] [[season]]s resulted in the formation of storm [[cloud]]s over the sea that released rain and lightning. By that [[time]], [[New Republic pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles]] allowed [[Temmin Wexley]], son of fellow [[New Republic]] [[pilot]] [[Norra Wexley]], to perform training exercises in an [[X-wing starfighter]] above the Silver Sea. When Temmin boarded the [[starship]] ''[[Halo]]'' to meet with his [[Parent|mother]] and her [[Norra Wexley's team|crew]], the [[Star|sun]] rose over the Silver Sea. Later, Antilles had Temmin fly over the sea in a [[flight simulator]]. In the simulator, Temmin repeatedly crashed his [[starfighter]], including an instance where he flew close to the sea's surface to avoid [[sensor array]]s.<ref name="Life Debt" />

[[File:ClimateSimulator.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Stones from the Silver Sea were brought aboard the ''Halcyon'' and stored in the Climate Simulator.]]
A [[Cantina|tavern]] that was located above the Silver Sea was frequented by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Desertion|defector]] [[Sinjir Rath Velus]] near the end of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic. After the [[Battle of Jakku]]<ref name="Empire's End" /> in [['ABY-BBY' dating system|5 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> which ended the conflict, Velus and several of his friends visited the tavern. During their visit, [[Chandrila's moon]] brightened the sea. At the end of their night, Velus and his last remaining companion, [[bounty hunter]] [[Jas Emari]], stood and spoke outside the tavern as wind blew off the Silver Sea and waves crashed below them.<ref name="Empire's End" />

An [[alcohol]]ic drink called the [[Silver Sea Martini]] was served aboard [[Chandrila Star Line]]'s [[MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser|MPO-1400 ''Purgill''-class star cruiser]] ''[[Halcyon]]''<ref name="Lounge">{{GSAttr|Sublight Lounge}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Starcruiserdate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]] to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Like the sea,<ref name="Life Debt" /> the drink was gray in color.<ref name="Lounge" /> The ''Halcyon'' also contained a courtyard known as the [[Climate Simulator]], which contained stones collected from the Silver Sea.<ref name="ClimateSimulator">{{GSAttr|Climate Simulator}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Silver Sea first appeared in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' canon in [[Chuck Wendig]]'s [[2016]] novel, ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'', the second book of the [[Star Wars: The Aftermath Trilogy|''Aftermath Trilogy'']].<ref name="Life Debt" /> The Silver Sea was first introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> and made its first full appearance in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second book in the ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'' and ninth overall in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' series.<ref name="NJO Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
